summary: 24-year-old Florida man became disoriented snowshoeing alone near Flattop Mountain in the Mill Creek Drainage; he called rangers early in the afternoon seeking directions, kept moving, then asked for assistance after dark as he was not prepared to spend the night; three park search teams followed fresh snowshoe tracks and found him around 8:45 p.m. in thick timber along Mill Creek, then snowshoed out with him.
location: Mill Creek Drainage near Flattop Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers (three search teams)
